ShortDescription.Value: Select an area and turn it into roads, a parking lot, a park, shops or about 30 other kinds of places. You see a preview first, then build it in one go.

Publish.LongDescription:
Placemaker fills an area for you. Select some land, choose what you want there, check the preview and build it.
[Watch the showcase video on YouTube](https://www.youtube.com/watch?v=ghIR5UhFwj4) (3 minutes).
It only uses the game's own assets, so no asset packs are needed.
**How to use**
1. Click the Placemaker button at the top left, or press Ctrl+Shift+A. 2. Select an area: click a city block, click corners, brush it on, or click the road nodes around it. 3. Choose a type and a style. The preview updates as you go. 4. Press Build. Undo works if you don't like it.
**What's in it**
- Roads: street grids connected to the roads around them - Parking: lots of any shape, with trees, lamps and fences - Parks: parks, gardens, memorial parks, playgrounds, amphitheatres - Beach: sand painted from the water's edge, quays and boardwalks - Shops & squares: strip malls, mall districts, market squares, transit plazas - Nature: wetlands, reserves, lookout hills, hiking trails, campgrounds - Farms and Sports: farmsteads, animal parks, sports parks, golf, a skate spot
Most types have a few styles. Settings are under Options > Placemaker.
**Early version**
Roads, parking and parks are the most finished. Shops and squares still need work. Known issues:
- The strict grid and superblock road presets build nothing yet - Big builds can freeze the game for a second or two - Shops in plazas and market squares face the city street
If something looks wrong, please report it with a screenshot and your Placemaker.log (in the game's Logs folder).
